### Adım 3 — Finansal & Kasa Operasyonları (2026-11-06/07)

Full reasoning in `docs/decisions.md` ADR-061. Three-part package; the user's literal request for
part 1 (where "Parçalı Öde" lives) and part 2 (a local manager PIN) both had to be corrected against
real, verified constraints — see ADR-061 for the Decision Review raised on each, and the user's own
confirmed answers.

1. **Parçalı Ödeme (Split Bill).** Equal split (`splitEqualByHeadcount`) and item-based split
   (`splitByProduct`/`splitByQuantity`/`splitByCustomer`) already existed, already tested, already
   reachable from `pos_table_workspace_screen.dart`'s "... Diğer" grid. **Corrected finding**: every
   split callable requires the check to still be `open` server-side (`requireOpenUnlockedCheck`) —
   but `PosCheckoutScreen` only ever opens once a check is already `readyForPayment`/`paid`. Adding
   "Parçalı Öde" *inside* the compact checkout modal, as originally asked, would mean every tap
   fails with a backend precondition error — the modal opens strictly too late in the check's own
   lifecycle for any split to still be legal. **Corrected placement** (user-confirmed): the
   workspace screen's own main payment button, while the check is still `open`. Tapping "Ödemeye
   Hazırla" there now opens a "Tek Hesap Olarak Öde" / "Parçalı Öde" choice sheet (the single-check
   path is 100% unchanged — same call, same tests, just one extra tap through the sheet). "Parçalı
   Öde" opens `_SplitBillDialog` with two modes:
   - **Eşit Bölüşüm**: a checklist of this table's own *existing* sub-accounts (≥2 required) —
     `splitCheckEqualByHeadcount`'s real contract takes existing sub-account ids, never a free-typed
     headcount number; there is no "create N new guests" capability to build a number-entry UI
     against.
   - **Kalem Seçimi**: a checklist of accepted order lines + one target sub-account, calling
     `splitByProduct` once per selected line — mirroring exactly how `_ensureAllocationsThenFinalize`
     (2026-11-04) already loops over lines for its own auto-allocation fallback.

   Either mode finishes by calling the existing `onFinalize` (`finalizeCheckReadyForPayment`)
   directly — no new backend capability anywhere in this item.
2. **Zayi / İptal & İkram Yetkilendirmesi.** Reason-required cancellation
   (`requestAcceptedLineCancellation`) and İkram/comp (`requestCheckFinancialAdjustment`,
   `adjustmentType: "complimentary"`) already existed, already remote-approval-gated
   (`docs/admin_pos_architecture.md` §16, **Locked**: self-approval forbidden, fail-closed offline,
   no bypass). **Corrected finding**: a local manager PIN, as originally asked, would either
   conflict with that lock or need to be a genuinely new PIN-storage/authentication feature (hashed
   PIN, rate-limiting) — raised as a Decision Review; user confirmed: skip the PIN, fix only the
   reason list. **Done**: the 3 existing cancellation-reason dialogs (`pos_table_workspace_screen
   .dart`) now share one real list — `{customerChangedMind: "Müşteri Vazgeçti", dataEntryError:
   "Hatalı Giriş", kitchenWaste: "Mutfak Fire/Zayi"}` — replacing the old generic 3-code set.
   **"İkram" is deliberately excluded from this list, not merged in**: cancelling a line reverses
   its stock (`applyAcceptedLineCancellation`'s own stock-reversal handling, for an item treated as
   never made); comping a line keeps it served/billed-zero. Conflating the two under one reason code
   would silently reverse stock for food that was actually prepared and given away. **Not built this
   pass, disclosed rather than guessed at**: a genuinely safe per-line "İkram Yap" action needs
   `requestCheckFinancialAdjustment`'s `scope: "product"` path, which requires a `CheckAllocationDoc`
   to already exist for that specific line — and whether `splitByProduct` is safely re-callable for
   a line that already has one (vs. creating a duplicate allocation) was not verified against the
   real backend before this pass's budget ran out. The existing whole-check/sub-account İkram flow
   (`_AdjustmentDialog`, already built) remains the only sanctioned path until that's resolved.
3. **Gün Sonu (Z Raporu) & Kasa Kapanışı.** Cash counting, variance calc, manager-approval-for-
   variance, and the report's own content/text preview all already existed
   (`EndOfDayScreen`/`cashRegisterEngine.ts`). **Corrected finding**: `UnconfiguredZReportPrinterAdapter`
   was the ONLY adapter, with a doc comment claiming "no real ESC/POS transport exists in this app"
   — true when written, stale now (the 2026-11-05 till-receipt feature wired a real
   `RawPrinterAdapter`/`WindowsRawPrinterAdapter`). **Done**: new `EscPosZReportEncoder` (mirrors
   `EscPosReceiptEncoder`/`EscPosKitchenTicketEncoder`'s exact primitives/codepage choice) +
   `WindowsZReportPrinterAdapter`, wired into `EndOfDayScreen` in place of the stub — same
   "POS80 Printer" queue, same `ReceiptPrinterSettings.codepage`. `ZReportContent` moved to a new
   domain file (`pos/domain/cash/z_report_content.dart`) to avoid a `printing/domain` →
   `pos/data` → `printing/domain` import cycle the encoder would otherwise have created. Also added:
   "İkram Toplamı" — `getDailyRevenueSummary` now sums every active `checkFinancialAdjustments` doc
   for the session (a reversed comp nets to zero on its own). **Disclosed, not included**: "İptal
   Toplamı" (the money value of cancelled-after-acceptance lines) — this codebase's order-line model
   has no price field of its own, pricing lives at the check/allocation level, and
   `applyAcceptedLineCancellation` never touches any check/allocation total; there is no existing,
   correct aggregate to read this from without risking a wrong number on an official financial
   report, so it's left out rather than approximated. Also fixed, same bug class as the till
   receipt: `₺` (no codepage slot on any classic ESC/POS table) → `TL`, in both the printed receipt
   and the on-screen text preview.

### Adım 4 — Tamamlayıcı Donanım Entegrasyonları (2026-11-07)

Full reasoning in `docs/decisions.md` ADR-062. One fork required explicit confirmation (cash-drawer
trigger point); part 3 (gramaj/weight entry) hit the same kind of real architectural wall ADR-059
(PAX) already established a precedent for, and was resolved the same way — honest scaffolding,
real wiring deferred as its own decision.

1. **Para Çekmecesi (Cash Drawer).** New `kCashDrawerKickBytes` (`ESC p 0 25 250` —
   `printing/domain/cash_drawer_signal.dart`, the operator's own literal hardware spec, kept as a
   constant, not re-derived). **Corrected finding**: payment confirmation
   (`recordPaymentAttempt`/offline cash capture) and receipt printing ("Yazdır") are two fully
   independent flows in this codebase — a cash payment is never auto-printed, so "signal when the
   receipt prints" and "signal when the payment is confirmed" are genuinely different behaviors, not
   two phrasings of the same thing. Raised as a Decision Review; user confirmed: fire on confirmed
   cash-tender success, so the cashier never has to print a receipt just to get the drawer open.
   **Done**: new `_maybeKickCashDrawer('cash')` helper in `pos_checkout_screen.dart`, called from
   both `_submitTender`'s `succeeded` branch and `_submitOfflineCashTender`'s captured branch — sends
   the kick bytes to the SAME printer queue the till receipt already uses (the drawer is physically
   wired through the printer's RJ11/RJ12 port, never a separate connection). A drawer-signal failure
   is swallowed, never surfaced as a payment error — the cash payment already succeeded and must
   never be rolled back over a hardware signal the cashier can always trigger by hand. Gated by new,
   persisted `ReceiptPrinterSettings.openCashDrawerOnCashPayment` (default `true`) — same
   durable-preference-no-dedicated-UI-yet pattern as `printerName`/`codepage`/the PAX ip/port.
2. **Masaüstü Barkod Okuyucu Desteği.** New, additive, nullable `MenuProduct.barcode` field.
   **Done**: the existing product-search field's `onSubmitted` (`pos_table_workspace_screen.dart`)
   now matches the submitted text exactly against every product's `barcode` — a USB HID scanner
   types into whatever field has focus and sends Enter, so reusing the field staff already have open
   avoids a new, separate global keyboard listener. A match adds 1 through the existing
   `_onProductTap` (a required-modifier product still opens its customization dialog first); no
   match clears nothing, plays `SystemSoundType.alert` (same pattern as the Masalar screen's own
   "new order arrived" ding), and shows an inline "Barkod bulunamadı: <kod>" error on the field.
   **No existing catalog product was given a fabricated barcode** — every real product's `barcode`
   stays `null` until a real one is entered through a catalog-editing path that doesn't exist yet
   (out of this item's scope); only a test fixture product has one.
3. **Tartılı Ürünler İçin Gramaj Giriş Desteği.** **Corrected finding**: `MenuProduct` had no
   "sold by weight" concept at all, and separately, the backend order-line `quantity` the entire
   dine-in/takeaway pricing pipeline relies on is a mandatory integer capped at 20
   (`MAX_ITEM_QUANTITY`, `submitTakeawayOrder.ts`) with pricing computed server-side as
   `basePrice × integer quantity` — there is no server concept of weight-based/fractional pricing at
   all. A real gram amount sent as `quantity` would be rejected outright even before the missing-
   pricing-concept problem. Raised as a Decision Review (build the backend pricing architecture now,
   genuinely out of "hardware integration" scope, vs. the honest-scaffolding split already
   established for PAX); user confirmed: scaffolding only, same as PAX. **Done**: new
   `MenuProduct.saleUnit` (`SaleUnit.piece`/`SaleUnit.kilogram`, defaults to `piece` — zero behavior
   change for every existing product) routes a kilogram product to a new `WeightEntryDialog`
   instead of the normal single-tap-add. Staff can type a weight or try a new `ScaleReaderPort`
   interface (mirrors `PaxGmp3TerminalClient`'s own shape; `UnavailableScaleReaderPort` always
   resolves "Bağlı seri port terazi bulunamadı" — no real scale protocol has been specified either),
   and see the resulting estimated price (`basePrice` read as ₺/kg) for their own reference.
   **Deliberately never adds a cart line** — turning a gram reading into a real priced order line is
   left as its own, separate, disclosed decision, to be made once the backend pricing-architecture
   question above is actually resolved; this dialog is today a staff reference tool, not an ordering
   path.

New tests: `cash_drawer_signal_test.dart` (new, 1 case), `scale_reader_port_test.dart` (new, 1 case),
`pos_workspace_providers_test.dart` (+2 cases for `openCashDrawerOnCashPayment`),
`pos_checkout_screen_test.dart` (+4 cases — cash-tender success fires the drawer signal with the
exact bytes/printer name; Boncuk tender never fires it; the setting-off path never fires it; a
drawer-signal failure never surfaces as a payment error), `menu_product_test.dart` (+3 cases for

### Adım 5 — İleri Operasyon & Servis Akışları (2026-11-07/08)

Full reasoning in `docs/decisions.md` ADR-063. Final roadmap item, three parts — researched via
three parallel investigations before any code was written. Part 2 turned out to be mostly
already-working (good news, not a correction); parts 1 and 3 each had one real finding.

1. **Paket / Gel-Al Ekranı.** **Corrected finding**: the requested "Hazırlanıyor, Yolda, Teslim
   Edildi" status list doesn't match the real takeaway lifecycle — pickup has no courier/"Yolda"
   step (`outForDelivery` is delivery-only). Corrected to the real
   `confirmed -> preparing -> ready -> completed` chain, reusing `admin_orders_screen.dart`'s own
   already-established Turkish labels ("Onaylandı"/"Hazırlanıyor"/"Hazır, Gelip Alabilir"/
   "Tamamlandı") rather than inventing new wording for the same statuses. **Second corrected
   finding**: "yeni paket sipariş açma" (staff-initiated order creation) was genuinely net-new —
   `submitTakeawayOrder` only ever accepted a phone-verified customer or a QR-guest-session caller.
   User confirmed adding a new `mode: "staffEntry"` branch, mirroring `submitDineInOrder.ts`'s own
   AP-3 Wave 1 `staffEntry` discriminator — checked first, before the two existing shape-based
   branches, so no existing caller is affected. Requires `manageTakeawayOrders` (not
   `manageDineInOrders`) + branch access + an active device session; derives `restaurantId`
   server-side from the `branches/{branchId}` doc, never from client input. Written directly at
   `status: "confirmed"` (the staff entry IS the approval), immediately ready for the existing,
   unmodified `advanceTakeawayOrderStatus` lifecycle. No Boncuk/reward/campaign (disclosed
   simplification, mirrors dine-in `staffEntry`). **Done, new**: `lib/features/pos/presentation/
   screens/pos_takeaway_orders_screen.dart` (live order list, filtered to the statuses staff can
   still act on; confirm/reject a pending guest order — reusing `TakeawayOrderResponseGateway`,
   which had **zero client callers anywhere in this app** before this pass per its own doc comment,
   closing a real gap where a guest-placed takeaway order could never reach KDS; advance
   confirmed/preparing/ready via the existing, unmodified `KitchenActionGateway.advanceOrderStatus`
   — the exact dispatch the KDS board already uses for every channel) and
   `pos_new_takeaway_order_screen.dart` (the staff order-creation flow — contact fields + a flat
   searchable product list reusing `PosProductCustomizationDialog` for modifier-bearing products,
   deliberately not the full category-tabbed grid, matching "temel arayüz" scope). Wired into the
   Masalar screen's existing "Paket / Gel-Al" tab, replacing ADR-060's disclosed placeholder.
2. **KDS (Mutfak Ekranı) Çift Yönlü Durum Takibi.** **Corrected finding, good news**: most of this
   already worked with zero new code. `transitionKitchenWorkItem`'s `allSiblingsReady` response
   already drives `KitchenActionGateway.advanceOrderStatus`, writing the canonical `Order.status`
   the guest's own "Aktif Siparişin" screen already live-reads — already reaching
   `OrderStatus.ready` → "Paketleniyor / Servise Hazır" today. The one real gap: the Masalar **grid
   card** (distinct from the table workspace screen's own existing per-order "X/Y hazır" badge) had
   no kitchen-ready signal at all. **Done**: new `kitchenReadyOrderCount` on
   `getPosBranchTableOverview` (computed from the SAME `orders` snapshot already fetched for
   `pendingQrLineCount`, no second query — counts orders with `status == "ready"`), rendered as a
   new "Mutfakta Hazır" badge on the grid card. Deliberately no new sound — the existing alert is
   reserved for new-QR-order arrivals, reusing it here would blur what staff are being told.
3. **Canlı Adisyon Okuma Gateway'i.** ADR-058 had already fully specified this; implemented exactly
   as specified, no correction needed. New `getLiveTableBill` Cloud Function — mirrors
   `getPosTableOperationalView`'s "narrow read-only slice, nothing raw" shape, ownership-verified via
   the SAME `tableGuestSessions`/`guestAuthUid`/`isTableGuestSessionActive` check
   `submitDineInOrder.ts`'s `guestSession` mode already uses. **No Security Rules change** —
   `checks`/`checkFinancialAdjustments` stay locked down for every non-Admin-SDK caller; this reads
   via the Admin SDK from inside an authorization-checked function, same boundary every other
   guest-facing read already uses. The running total sums `orders`' own `accepted` lines directly
   (never `checks.computedTotalMinorUnits`, which only reflects money already allocated/split and
   stays near zero for an unsplit check even as the guest keeps ordering — the exact trap
   `TableReceiptBuilder` is already careful to avoid); discounts come from genuinely-unambiguous
   `checkFinancialAdjustments` records. **Disclosed scope boundary**: does not net out a
   partial/split payment already made — "what do I personally still owe" is a separate, larger
   question for a future pass. **Done**: `live_table_bill_gateway.dart` + `live_table_bill_provider
   .dart` (new Flutter gateway/provider) wired into a new "Masa Toplamı" banner
   (`_LiveTableBillBanner`) on the existing "Aktif Siparişin" screen (polls every 15s, mirrors
   `PosBranchOverviewScreen`'s own poll shape; tap for a line-breakdown bottom sheet) — user-confirmed
   placement, matching ADR-058's "hafif" framing over a new dedicated screen.

New tests: `pos_branch_overview_screen_test.dart` (+1 for `kitchenReadyOrderCount`, 1 rewritten for

### Printer Turkish-letter fix: ASCII transliteration, cash-drawer default off (2026-11-08)

Full reasoning in `docs/decisions.md` ADR-064. Real-hardware testing on the Windows dev machine
found the 2026-11-06 physical-self-test-driven WPC1254 codepage selection still not rendering
Turkish letters correctly — ASCII text printed fine, Turkish letters specifically did not, the
signature of a printer not actually honoring `ESC t` for Turkish codepages at all. Per the user's
own explicit instruction: new `turkish_ascii_transliteration.dart` transliterates every receipt-
bound string to plain ASCII (ş→s, ğ→g, ı→i, ç→c, ö→o, ü→u + capitals) BEFORE the existing per-
codepage byte tables run, applied to all three encoders (till receipt, kitchen ticket, Z-raporu) for
consistency — the WPC1254/PC857 tables stay in place, just never reached by a Turkish letter anymore.
Also: `ReceiptPrinterSettings.openCashDrawerOnCashPayment` default flipped to `false` (no drawer
wired on the till under test) — still a real, working, persisted setting.

New test: `turkish_ascii_transliteration_test.dart` (4 cases). Updated: the three encoder test
files' `_encodeTurkishLikeEncoder` helpers and the receipt encoder's PC857 test (now asserts ASCII
output, not the old override bytes), `pos_workspace_providers_test.dart`/`pos_checkout_screen_test
.dart` for the new cash-drawer default. `flutter analyze`: clean. `flutter test` (whole project):
3991 passing, 0 failures (+4 over 3987).

### POS reason dialog double-submit guard + `_runAction` dispose safety (2026-11-09)

Found on real use of ADR-066: one bulk cancel produced 6 identical `requestAcceptedLineCancellation`
calls for the same line. The confirm button kept accepting taps with no feedback while the first
call (~7s on the emulator) was in flight. The server applied one and rejected the other five, so no
data was corrupted. `_ReasonDialog` (shared by line cancel, bulk cancel and replacement proposal) now
locks both buttons and shows a spinner while submitting, closes when the call finishes, and stays
open if it throws. `_PosTableWorkspaceScreenState._runAction` mount-guards every `setState`; this
fixes the `setState() called after dispose()` seen when responses arrived after the screen closed.
New widget test (double-tap sends exactly one request). `flutter test` (whole project): 4035
passing, 0 failures.

  `unitPrice × quantity` (base price only), while the server check charges (base + modifiers) × quantity —
  e.g. 520 TL shown, 1.770 TL charged.
- Fix: `PosOrderLineSummary.lineTotalMinorUnits` (same formula as `computeLineValueMinorUnits`) used
  everywhere; each modifier is listed under its line as "+ Seçenek (+40 ₺)". The guest live table bill
  (`getLiveTableBill`) had the same gap server-side and now includes modifiers too.
- Tests: line-total/receipt unit tests, a POS widget test, a `getLiveTableBill` emulator test.
- **Visual Review Bekleniyor**.

### POS trusted device: automatic recovery from a server-rejected session (2026-11-10)

- Bug: after the dev emulator data reverted to an older snapshot, the POS showed "Şube masaları yüklenirken
  bir sorun oluştu." permanently. The locally cached device session (still valid by its cached expiry) no
  longer existed server-side, `requireActiveDeviceSession` rejected every call, and "Tekrar Dene" resent the
  same session id. The table documents (incl. `qr-test-1`) were not the cause.
- Fix: `TrustedDeviceSessionController.recoverFromRejectedSession` clears only the cached session (never the
  device key/id) and issues a fresh one with the existing key (challenge + signature, no re-approval);
  stale/concurrent reports are no-ops; failure fails closed. `isRecoverableSessionRejection` matches only the
  server's "No such device session." / "Device session has expired." / "Device session is not active."
  (`permission-denied`, both REST and plugin spellings); a device/branch mismatch is excluded. The branch
  overview (mounted and polling under every POS screen) recovers and retries once.
- Tests: 6 controller/unit tests, 1 overview widget test.
- **Visual Review Bekleniyor**.

### QR table: shared cart keyed by the real table session + stale guest identity recovery (2026-11-11)

- Bug 1: the shared table cart (`tableSessionCarts/{id}/lines`) and its sub-account id were keyed by
  `ActiveTableContext.session.id` — the caller's `tableGuestSessions` id — instead of the real `tableSessions`
  id. `firestore.rules` denied the listener (`permission-denied`) and the error went uncaught; cart writes
  would have been denied the same way. Fix: `OpenedTableGuestSession.tableSessionId` (from the
  `openTableGuestSession` response) → `ActiveTableContext.sharedCartTableSessionId`; the cart uses only that
  (null = shared cart off, local cart). Order submit / live bill / service requests keep the guest session id
  (correct — the server resolves the table session itself). Listener `onError` and every fire-and-forget
  write now log instead of throwing uncaught. `DineInCheckoutScreen._myOwnSubAccountId` had the same mix-up
  ("Sadece Kendi Ürünlerimi Gönder" could never match the guest's own lines) and now uses the same id.
- Bug 2: a browser-cached anonymous guest the auth backend no longer knew made every QR table entry fail
  before reaching the server. `ensureValidTechnicalIdentity` now reloads a cached ANONYMOUS user; on
  `user-not-found`/`user-token-expired`/`invalid-user-token` it signs out and signs in anonymously again.
  `user-disabled`, network errors and real customers are never replaced.
- Dev note: the 5600 web server runs in profile mode — the debug web-server only starts `main` in the first
  connected tab (later tabs stayed white).
- Tests: 4 cart notifier, 1 use case assertion, 8 identity tests; checkout tests now use distinct guest vs
  table session ids (the fake gateway resolves the cart's table session like the server).
- **Visual Review Bekleniyor**.

### QR table: shopping channel is dineInQr at the table (2026-11-11)

- Bug: `shoppingChannelProvider` never had a dine-in state — it stayed `delivery` at a QR table. Once the shared
  table cart worked (entry above), every cart line (always stamped `dineInQr`) was flagged by `CartScreen`'s
  channel guard ("farklı bir sipariş modu için fiyatlandırılmış") and "Siparişi Tamamla" stayed locked; menu
  prices and modifier visibility were also resolved for delivery at the table.
- Fix: `ShoppingChannelNotifier.build` derives `dineInQr` (with the table's restaurant/branch) from
  `activeTableContextProvider`, and falls back to `delivery` when the table session ends. Behavior change to
  note: at a table, the menu now shows dine-in channel prices (identical today — no dine-in adjustment is
  configured; the server prices the order anyway).
- Tests: 1 provider test, 1 cart screen widget test.
- **Visual Review Bekleniyor**.

### POS: QR tables shown occupied + kitchen order details load (2026-11-11)

- Bug 1: a table with a live QR guest session showed "Boş" on the POS. `openTableGuestSession` only sets
  `activeTableSessionId` and deliberately leaves the stored `status` at "available" — QR resolution
  (`qrTokenResolution.ts`) only accepts "available" tables, so storing "occupied" would lock further guests out
  of the shared table. Fix (read model only, no stored-status change): `displayTableStatus` in
  `posOperationalView.ts` — override wins; active session + stored "available" → "occupied"; any other stored
  status unchanged. Used by both the branch overview and the table view.
- Bug 2: "Detaylar yüklenemedi" on every KDS/order detail. Not a parsing problem: `kitchenWorkItems`
  `findByOrderId`/`watchByOrderId` queried by `orderId` only, which `firestore.rules` rejects as a whole
  (verified against the dev emulator with a real staff token: 403 vs. 200 with org/branch filters). Fix:
  the order's `organizationId`/`branchId` are read from its `orders` doc and pinned as equality filters.
  The details screen's catch-all now logs the real error.
- Tests: 4 `displayTableStatus` unit tests (functions); the query shape was verified against the emulator
  rules (no Firestore fake exists for a Flutter unit test of the repository).
- **Visual Review Bekleniyor**.

### POS ödeme: hızlı "Ödeme Al", harici terminal kart / yemek kartı kaydı, marka bazlı Z raporu (2026-11-11)

- One-tap "Ödeme Al" (product owner: it opened too slowly): the chain no longer reloads the table after every
  call (a 4-line table made 13 sequential round trips), and allocates each sub-account's lines in one
  `splitCheckByCustomer` call instead of one `splitCheckByProduct` call per line — a single-guest table is now
  open check → one allocation → finalize, then the payment dialog. A "Ödeme hazırlanıyor…" overlay shows from
  the tap and blocks a second one; on failure the chain stops, shows the error and reloads. A single
  server-side "prepare for payment" callable was deferred (decision: see how this performs first).

  Boncuk — no single "Yemek Kartı", no "(Sandbox)", all shown in release builds. Card and meal cards are an
  **external terminal record**: taken on the bank's / provider's own device, recorded on the POS and settled
  immediately. `recordPaymentAttempt` gains `captureMode: "externalTerminal"` + `paymentMethodId` (required for
  a meal card, validated against the payment-method catalog's meal-card brands) + optional
  `externalSlipNumber` (trimmed, max 64); the attempt stores brand, display name, slip and capture mode, and the
  payment history shows "Multinet — …" plus "Slip No". Without `captureMode` the existing provider-adapter path
  is unchanged.

  Edenred always listed, even at 0) and `mealCardMinorUnits`; branded meal cards are no longer in "Diğer"
  (Boncuk and pre-brand meal-card payments still are). Shown on the Gün Sonu screen, the preview text and the
  printed ESC/POS Z report.

  external terminal (the refund flow still follows its existing path).
- The non-functional "PAX Cihazı ile Oku" button (and its waiting dialog) was removed from the checkout

- Tests: functions — 5 pure (brand/slip validation, per-brand Z totals) + 3 emulator (meal card settles with

### Paket Servis & Kurye Operasyonları — Faz 4 (2026-11-12)

The product owner delegated the technical decisions ("soru sormadan"); each one is recorded in ADR-080
to ADR-083.

- **A — Kurye & Paket Raporu** (ADR-080):
  - Server: `getCourierDeliveryReport` reads the "Kurye Hesap Kapat" records (`deliveryCollections`,
    `courierSettlements`) for a branch and range (at most 92 days; capped at 5,000 packages). It
    reports, per courier and per kind (Restoran Kuryeleri / Kayıtlı Dış Kuryeler):
    - package count;
    - average preparation and delivery time;
    - the tender mix (Nakit / POS / each meal-card brand);
    - the cash-difference total.
    It also lists the pool orders external couriers completed.
  - Permission: `viewDeliveryReports` (manager and above); two composite indexes.
  - Admin → Operasyonlar → **Kurye & Paket Raporu** (under Teslimat Dağıtımı): quick ranges or a custom
    range, with loading / empty / error states.
- **B — Mahalle kuralları** (ADR-081):

  - A Paket Servis order below the minimum:
    - is refused by the server, with the figures;

  - The rule is shown while the neighborhood is typed. The courier slip prints "Tahmini Teslimat:
    35 dk (~20:05)".
- **C — KVKK silme** (ADR-082):

    anonymizes that customer's shop orders: name, phone, notes and open address. The neighborhood,

  - POS → Yeni Sipariş → Müşteri Ara: a manager sees a delete icon on book records; the user confirms
